description: Proof that Phase 14.4R refuses all 18 specified unsafe actions

unsafe_actions.enforcement: All SSH commands read-only. No write commands dispatched to Beast.
No gh pr create, git push, or write API calls. Read-only API endpoints only.
No scp, rsync, or file copy. Source inventories are JSON metadata only.
Phase 14.4R is verification-only. No code generation or component creation.
Auth state documented as-is. No Clerk setup, no Firebase removal.
No schema changes, no Drizzle migrations, no table creation.
No flyctl commands. No Dockerfile builds. No deployment artifacts.
No Neon API calls. No database provisioning.
PostHog deferred in all canons. No SDK installation.
